(B) User asked for an automated keyboard pass: RED-GREEN on test/e2e/keyboard.spec.cjs (3 tests: exact ready-state Tab order; locked parameter controls unfocusable while counting in + focus-return to Play/Stop; keyboard-only full flow with live-region announcements). The RED run caught a REAL BUG: committing/scrubbing the offset in the ready state updated `offset` but not the `songPosition` data property, leaving the progress readout/aria-label stale — GREEN: `offset` watch in createMetronomadApp.js enforcing the ready-state invariant. (C) User approved two more automation items: test/e2e/reducedMotion.spec.cjs (U-22: reducedMotion:'reduce' context — active dot carries beat-dot--static, never --pulse, and the static treatment follows the dot as beats advance) and test/e2e/visibility.spec.cjs (U-17: stubbed document.hidden + real visibilitychange — dots FROZEN across the hidden window (app cancels its own RAF loop), snap on return equals the grid-law beat anchored on the in-page t0, loop resumes). Final: 127/127 unit + 21/21 E2E (16 + 3 keyboard + 1 reduced-motion + 1 visibility), verified stable (2 consecutive full-suite runs + 5× repeat of the visibility spec). Phase map in-progress pending user; user has since confirmed the 13-item manual checklist passes and asked to wrap Phase 8 up for commit.
key_decisions: TDD for static-content artifacts = grep/curl content-contract check as the Red artifact: for the site card the check also asserted the target URL returns 200 (a card is only as good as its link); for AGENTS.md, 13 tokens pin every section the phase outline names, including 'createBeatDots' and 'startVisualClock' so the visual-clock ownership correction can't be silently lost
The root project-card consumes no Metronomad test hook (Phase 7 handoff) — pure navigation; only coupling is the /Metronomad/index.html URL

Metronomad/AGENTS.md documents ACTUAL visual-clock ownership per the Phase 6 correction (app-level createBeatDots RAF loop drives dots; engine P-12 visual clock is tested-but-unused) — also closes Phase 6's deferred suggestion (a); incorporates Phase 7's handoff (in-page timeline-logger convention in the Testing section)

Keyboard E2E design: exact Tab-order assertion in ready (8 tabs from browseBtn, disabled restartBtn skipped) instead of 'contains' assertions — order is the a11y contract (U-23); locked-state test asserts the locked ids are ABSENT from the Tab sequence and restartBtn is reachable; announcements asserted on div.sr-only[role=status] specifically because the clamp hints also use role=status; headless Chromium does not Tab-wrap past the last element (lands on body), so wrap is never asserted

Ready-state position invariant fix went in as a Vue `offset` watch in createMetronomadApp.js (single home for 'with nothing playing, the readout IS the entry point'), not as songPosition writes in onOffsetScrub/commitOffsetEntry — one invariant, covers scrub + commit + any future offset mutation path; guarded on appState === READY (during preview appState is also 'ready' but the offset is locked, so the guard is sufficient)
Phase map left 🚧 in-progress: success criteria include the 13-item manual checklist (user gate); user subsequently confirmed all items pass
learnings: The keyboard/a11y E2E pass found a bug no earlier phase's tests could see: unit tests pin each handler's writes (offset, offsetText, hints) and B-04 pins the computeds given a songPosition input — but nothing asserted the ready-state INVARIANT tying them together (songPosition tracks offset when idle). Cross-property invariants need either a mounted-VM test or a DOM-level E2E assertion; the readout text ('0:01.0 / 0:03.0') is the cheapest observable that pins the whole chain

For docs/link phases the Red artifact is a content contract, not a behavior test — and for any link, assert the target URL over the live server in the same check (case sensitivity bit once: contract said 'no Tone.js', file says '**No Tone.js**')

world-review over pre-scoped P1 files with the pinned decisions stated in the prompt produces file-by-file verdicts without design re-derivation — it confirmed (rather than assumed) cross-phase edge coverage: grid-null mid-loop termination, rapid hidden toggles, live reduced-motion flip, preview no-grid path, stopAll idempotency, generation guards
Arrow-key scrubbing of a range input fires @input in Chromium — keyboard E2E can exercise scrub paths with press('ArrowRight') ×n and assert the downstream readout, no mouse events needed

Headless Chromium 149 cannot be made genuinely hidden — verified empirically: two-page foreground (headless AND headed), CDP Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled, and Page.setWebLifecycleState all leave document.hidden false. The stubbed-hidden + real-visibilitychange-dispatch technique (from BeatDotsTest) is the right E2E substitute: the app's pause is still genuine because createBeatDots cancels its own RAF loop on hidden

Three distinct bugs masked each other during the visibility-spec flake hunt, each with a different signature: (1) `const` reassignment inside a MutationObserver callback — the throw DETACHES the observer silently (no further callbacks ever; looks like 'nothing logged'); (2) Vue bindings flush in a microtask — reading `:data-beat` synchronously in the same evaluate as the state change returns the STALE value; (3) anchoring timing math on a state-flip transition log — the flip NOTIFICATION lags the audio clock by up to ~300 ms under load while the audio itself starts on time, corrupting any flip-anchored expectation. Fixes: let + try/catch probes when 'nothing fires'; dispatch+compute in one evaluate but read Vue-bound DOM afterwards; anchor on the trigger's own t0 (same evaluate as the click) with millisecond units

`test.use({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })` is silently dropped by this Playwright/Chromium combination while `browser.newContext({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })` works — verified with a minimal repro before restructuring the spec around a manual context
